name: Hayward Gallery (Southbank Centre)
funding: £38M Southbank Centre operating budget. Arts Council England National Portfolio Organisation (NPO), admissions, and Southbank Centre trust.

name: Institute of Contemporary Arts (ICA)
funding: The ICA is an Arts Council England National Portfolio Organisation. Its income also comes from donations and legacies, charitable activities and programme trading.

name: London Museum
funding: The City of London Corporation and the Greater London Authority are responsible for funding the museum under the Museum of London Act 1965.

name: Raven Row
funding: Funded by Alex Sainsbury, who says the money is his, through the Glass-House Trust he settled.

name: Serpentine Galleries
funding: £9.8M annual budget. Arts Council England National Portfolio Organization (NPO), Bloomberg Philanthropies public pavilion commissions, individual patron circle. Always free admission.

name: The Photographers' Gallery
funding: £4.3M income (FY2025). Arts Council England £919k, Westminster City Council, Deutsche Börse Photography Foundation to 2027, Leica, Polaroid, MPB, Speroni Foundation, John Lyon's Charity, Kusuma Trust.

name: The Showroom
funding: Arts Council England National Portfolio Organisation (NPO), Paul Hamlyn Foundation, Esmée Fairbairn Foundation. Registered Charity No. 1055262.

name: Castlefield Gallery
funding: £671k income (FY2025). Arts Council England (to 2027/28), Manchester City Council, Haworth Trust, Brian Mercer Trust, Fenton Arts Trust, corporate and individual donors.

name: The NewBridge Project
funding: Funders include Arts Council England and Newcastle City Council.

name: Primary
funding: Arts Council England funds it as a National Portfolio Organisation.
